'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Rustin Sharer DS Contract Killers''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Rustin Sharer]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
